AGREED

Details · Notes · Deliverables.

POC merged in under Details, which is what takes the switcher from four names to three. Assignment Details renamed to Details.

Tabs are clickable.

Work Performed -> Notes.  Report is already taken in this app (the client-facing report, the Exports card, the Report .txt button) so a tab called Report that is not the report is a trap. Work says nothing on a page where every tab is work. The card inside keeps the name Work performed, because that is what the exports call it.

If Notes reads too casual for text that reaches the client report, Summary is the runner-up.
Kept for the record: where the 4,222px goes, and why 1,152px of it leaves the technician's view before any tab is drawn.
Not chosen, kept for the record.
